editorial:
You are in for a treat with this zany classic from Chuck Jones. It features the mischievous duo Hubie and Bertie, two mice who just can't stop messing with Claude the cat. Usually, they are just trying to survive, but here they find Claude acting like a total wreck, thinking he is dying of every disease known to man. The vibe is pure chaos and slapstick humor. It is the kind of short that makes you laugh at the sheer absurdity of a cat being a hypochondriac while two tiny mice try to play doctor.

What really makes this one pop is the timing and the physical comedy. The way the mice perform a fake operation is fast and funny, keeping you hooked from start to finish. While it is a short film, the pacing never drags. It is a perfect pick for a family movie night.
endingExplained: The mice decide to cure Claude by performing a wild, makeshift surgery to remove his imaginary illness. After a lot of running around and funny medical mishaps, the operation ends in a chaotic mess. The twist is that Claude is not actually sick at all; he was just worrying too much. The short wraps up with the mice getting the upper hand, leaving the poor cat more stressed than when they started.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves classic Looney Tunes and slapstick humor.
